description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git stash' command with patch mode (-p). It contains test case definitions, setup procedures, and verification steps for various scenarios involving git stash interactions and patch application, primarily used in a testing framework like 'sh' or 'bash'.

methods.name: set_and_save_state
methods.description: Sets the current state of a file or directory and saves it for later verification.

methods.name: save_head
methods.description: Saves the current HEAD state for later comparison.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Configures the state of a particular file or directory for testing.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Simulates user input by writing lines to standard input for tests.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, used to ensure error conditions.

methods.name: verify_state
methods.description: Verifies that files or directories are in the expected state.

methods.name: verify_saved_state
methods.description: Checks that a previously saved state matches the current state.

methods.name: verify_saved_head
methods.description: Verifies that the HEAD state has not moved from its saved state.
